unextracted: a macro; the extractor records declarations, not macros
why:
phase-417 W4.d — rclrs spells this `rclrs::log_info`; we spell it `nros_info`. Same capability, different name, so this is a RENAME and not the `extension` it was first filed as. rclrs's logging macros were overlooked because the correlator pairs on NAME and `log_info` never matched `nros_info`.

Not yet executed. RFC-0089's end state is that we carry ROS 2's names, and the rename lands LAST -- after the shapes match -- because renaming first relabels a gap without closing one. The decision it is blocked on: rclrs says `log_info!`, rclcpp says `RCLCPP_INFO`, and C already ships `RCLC_LOG_INFO`. Following each language's own upstream is defensible; one spelling for all three is not obviously right.
